## Lessons Learned

- `cmd/muah-runner/main.go` written in previous session was never `git add`-ed — report_progress only commits tracked/staged files; always verify with `git status` after writing new files
- The CI workflow (`ci.yml`) builds `./cmd/muah-runner/` — if that file is missing, CI fails silently (no Go error, just "directory not found")
- `go build ./...` succeeds even without `cmd/` because it's just internal packages — always build the binary explicitly too
- The `muah-runner init` timed question correctly auto-selects after 10s in non-TTY mode
